name: io.github.igorshutko/horoshop-mcp
title: Horoshop MCP
description: Unofficial MCP server for Horoshop (Хорошоп) stores: catalog, orders, SEO, redirects, marketplace feeds, design and store settings through the public API, the admin panel and the storefront. 118 tools, many stores in one server.

environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_STORES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a JSON file mapping store name to { baseUrl, login, password }. Preferred over inlining credentials.

environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_STORES
environmentVariables.description: Same mapping inline as a JSON string. Use only when the client cannot read a file.

environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_DEFAULT_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Store used when a tool call omits the store argument. Set automatically when only one store is configured.

environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Default 120000, because catalog imports with images are slow.
